title: Product sync with retracted and rejected decisions
description: Two traps: dark mode is committed mid-meeting then explicitly cancelled ('scratch what I just said'), and a MongoDB evaluation is proposed then explicitly rejected ('I don't want that on the board'). Only the three surviving tasks should be extracted. Tests whether the agent tracks decision reversals instead of pattern-matching on 'let's do X'.

expected_tasks.name: Benchmark PgBouncer connection pooling for the dashboard workload
key_points: dashboard slowness is connection contention, not query cost (80% of time waiting on DB)
compare PgBouncer in transaction mode against current setup
load test mirroring the dashboard query pattern, compare p95 latency

expected_tasks.name: Fix 'recieve' typo in onboarding email subject line
key_points: typo is in the subject line of the onboarding email
push fix through the email template repo and get it re-approved

expected_tasks.name: Update roadmap doc to move dark mode under the design-system upgrade
key_points: roadmap currently shows dark mode as 'Q3 committed', which is now wrong
move it under the September design-system upgrade line so sales stops promising it standalone

must_not_extract.topic: build dark mode / theme system / asset variants
must_not_extract.reason: committed mid-meeting then explicitly cancelled: it ships with the September design-system upgrade
explicitly rejected: 'we're staying on Postgres, no migration, no evaluation task'
